parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the dispenser is made of durable plastic and is ergonomically shaped for gripping.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to actuate the trigger mechanism, allowing the user to spray liquid from the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves back and forth when pressed by the user’s fingers to pump liquid through the nozzle.

parts.name: Nose (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The nose is the front outlet of the dispenser head, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It directs and controls the spray pattern of the liquid being dispensed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but may include a rotatable tip to adjust the spray pattern.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head of the dispenser houses the trigger mechanism and nozzle assembly.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the handle and nozzle, channeling liquid from the bottle to the outlet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while internal components move during operation.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier part is a small external component, likely part of the nozzle or connector assembly.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a connector or stabilizer for the nozzle or head assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It typically remains fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of lightweight plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid that will be dispensed through the nozzle when the handle is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the reservoir for the liquid.
